# Glass text

Write updates as plain-text blocks. A block starts with `role: title`; the lines under it are:
- `- item`, or task steps `x done` and `> current`
- `field: value` for the role's other fields (table), and `ttl: 10m` on any role
- any other line: the body

`clear: role` removes a role (`clear: task, info`, `clear: all`). A new `role:` line starts a new block.

| role | for | fields |
|---|---|---|
| agenda | Today's schedule, reminders and plans. Refreshed each morning. | card fields |
| focus | A standing note the user wants in view (goal, shopping list, countdown). | card fields |
| task | What Claude is currently doing for the user: title, steps, progress bar. | card fields |
| info | An answer or summary the user asked Claude to put on the mirror. | card fields |
| notify | Short transient message: something finished, a reminder fired. | title 8 words / 37 chars |
| alert | Needs the user's attention now. Covers the mirror. Clear it once acknowledged. | title 4 words / 30 chars · body 74 chars |

Card fields: title 6 words / 36 chars · body 132 chars · ≤ 6 items × 41 chars · progress: 0-100.

weather and news are kept up by provider scripts: don't write them.

Writing:
- The title is the message, because most glances read only the title: "Train at 07:42", not "Train times".
- Put figures first. One fact per item, no full stops. Plain text only, no markdown or emoji.
- Text over a limit is cut at a word boundary.
